title: Give every window a place
summary: Arrange your working windows with Layout Presets, then use Shelf as a temporary stop for the files moving between them.
body:
Start with the windows you actually use for a task. Layout Presets previews arrangements for the focused workspace and applies the selected proportions to its tiled windows. It adapts its choices to the window count; stacked arrangements depend on the active tiling layout.

Shelf provides a separate place to park local files and folders at a screen edge. Drag an item onto it, then drag it into a destination app when you need it. It remembers paths, so removing a shelf entry does not delete the original file.

This is a workflow idea based on the two authors' documentation, rather than a tested integration between the plugins. Try each independently and choose the behavior that fits your workspace. The source links explain layout restrictions and Shelf's edge and pin settings.
